raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. raw_region_map gives an unambiguous code-to-name mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), and silver_customers does not apply it.
